verdict.rationale: MX is a financial-data API platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis. A probe found an official MCP server documented at docs.mx.com/mcp, but the pack contains no detail on what it exposes or how an agent connects. missing for 10: documented tool/resource list, authentication and setup instructions for agent clients, independent or hands-on corroboration of a working connection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://docs.mx.com/mcp
